subject: maths
question: A and B can do a work in 12 days and 18 days, respectively. They worked together for 4 days after which B was replaced by C and the remaining work was completed by A and C in the next 4 days. In how many days will C alone complete 50% of the same work?
solution:
Given:

A and B can do a work in 12 days and 18 days, respectively.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day (efficiency)× Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (12, 18) = 36

Let the total work be the LCM of the time taken by different workers.

Total work = 36 units

Efficiency of A = 36/12 = 3 units a day

Efficiency of B = 36/18 = 2 units
